parameters.name: gravity_nm
parameters.method: the gap: two clusters of (motor encoder - link camera) over every train row (bootstrap over runs); the M3 regression again on the 23,928 rows where the gear is in contact (the smoothed gap at a contact level, a half window from any traversal); then the static level and the drop polished by output error: Nelder-Mead on the motor encoder's RMS over the train operate runs replayed through the twin (40 replays, 0.466 mrad)
